name: What steps can I take to prevent mold damage after a repair?

mainEntity.name: What steps can I take to prevent mold damage after a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: After mold repair, prevention focuses on controlling moisture. Ensure good ventilation in bathrooms, kitchens, and basements. Fix any leaks promptly from pipes, roofs, or windows. Use dehumidifiers in damp areas to keep indoor humidity below 60%. Clean and dry areas that have been wet within 24-48 hours. Consider using mold-resistant paints or materials in high-moisture environments. Regular home maintenance and vigilance against water intrusion are key to preventing future mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by controlling moisture: fix leaks promptly, use dehumidifiers, ensure good ventilation, and dry wet areas within 24-48 hours.
